analysis.summary: A draft built on Maxey, VJ and LeBron, with Brown out and Embiid unlikely on the second night of a back-to-back. Houston is 14-5 with a top-10 defense, so the lines stay at or below the usual. The main risks are tired legs and LeBron's minutes on a back-to-back.

slips.Props only: Nine props: Maxey and VJ pts + reb + ast and threes, VJ and LeBron steals, LeBron pts + reb + ast and assists, and Simons 1+ three.
slips.With +5.5: The same eight core props plus the Sixers +5.5 in place of Simons' three, since they'll likely be underdogs.
